title: Python Backend & Systems

nodes.title: Python Data Model & Dunder Methods
nodes.subtitle: __init__, __str__, __repr__, __eq__, __hash__, __len__, custom container protocols
learning_objectives: Leverage Python dunder methods to build intuitive, pythonic classes
Implement custom collection classes supporting indexing and iteration
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental difference between __str__ and __repr__ in Python?
key_misconceptions: Defining mutable default arguments in functions (def fn(items=[])), creating shared state bugs

nodes.title: Iterators, Generators & Memory Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Iterables, iterators, yield statements, generator expressions, memory efficiency
learning_objectives: Stream and process massive datasets lazily without exhausting RAM using generators
Implement custom iterable classes using __iter__ and __next__
feynman_prompts: Why do generator expressions consume significantly less memory than list comprehensions?
key_misconceptions: Converting large database query streams into full lists with list(), exhausting server memory

nodes.title: Decorators & Context Managers
nodes.subtitle: Closures, functools.wraps, parameterized decorators, with statement, contextlib
learning_objectives: Author reusable function and method decorators preserving metadata with functools.wraps
Manage external resources (sockets, files, DB sessions) safely using context managers
feynman_prompts: Explain how the with statement guarantees cleanup even if an unexpected exception occurs.
key_misconceptions: Forgetting to use @functools.wraps on decorators, erasing the original function name and docstring

nodes.title: Type Hinting & Static Analysis with Mypy
nodes.subtitle: Typing module, Union, Optional, Literal, TypedDict, Generics, strict mypy checks
learning_objectives: Annotate Python codebases with comprehensive type hints to catch bugs before runtime
Configure strict mypy static type checking in continuous integration pipelines
feynman_prompts: Why does type hinting improve code maintainability and IDE auto-completion in large teams?
key_misconceptions: Assuming Python type hints enforce runtime type validation without runtime libraries like Pydantic

nodes.title: Asynchronous Programming with Asyncio
nodes.subtitle: async/await, event loop, Tasks, asyncio.gather, asyncio.run, non-blocking I/O
learning_objectives: Write high-concurrency asynchronous code using Python asyncio
Execute parallel asynchronous tasks cleanly with asyncio.gather and TaskGroups
feynman_prompts: Why does calling time.sleep() inside an async function freeze the entire asyncio event loop?
key_misconceptions: Calling synchronous blocking I/O functions inside async def endpoints instead of running in a thread pool

nodes.title: FastAPI Framework & Modern Web APIs
nodes.subtitle: Path operations, query/path parameters, status codes, OpenAPI docs, Starlette core
learning_objectives: Build production RESTful APIs using FastAPI with automatic OpenAPI Swagger documentation
Handle HTTP errors and custom exceptions cleanly with HTTPException handlers
feynman_prompts: How does FastAPI achieve high performance comparable to Node.js and Go?
key_misconceptions: Returning internal Python traceback strings to clients on server errors instead of clean JSON

nodes.title: Data Modeling & Validation with Pydantic v2
nodes.subtitle: BaseModel, Field validation, computed fields, model serializers, Rust core speed
learning_objectives: Enforce strict request and response schema validation using Pydantic v2 models
Write custom field validators and root validators to enforce business constraints
feynman_prompts: How does Pydantic v2's Rust-powered validation engine improve API serialization speed?
key_misconceptions: Using raw Python dictionaries instead of strongly-typed Pydantic schemas across service boundaries

nodes.title: FastAPI Dependency Injection System
nodes.subtitle: Depends(), yield dependencies, database session injection, auth guards, sub-dependencies
learning_objectives: Decouple services and inject database sessions cleanly using FastAPI Depends()
Implement reusable authentication and permission guards across API routes
feynman_prompts: Why is dependency injection via Depends() superior to importing global database session objects?
key_misconceptions: Sharing a single database session across multiple concurrent asynchronous requests

nodes.title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async ORM & Alembic Migrations
nodes.subtitle: declarative_base, async_sessionmaker, select(), joins, relationships, Alembic migrations
learning_objectives: Model relational database schemas using modern SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative syntax
Execute versioned schema migrations safely using Alembic
feynman_prompts: How does SQLAlchemy 2.0 select() syntax provide type-safe asynchronous database queries?
key_misconceptions: Running database migrations manually with raw SQL files instead of versioned Alembic revisions

nodes.title: PostgreSQL Indexing, Performance & EXPLAIN
nodes.subtitle: B-Tree indexes, composite indexes, query analysis with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, connection pooling
learning_objectives: Analyze slow database queries and optimize indexes using EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Configure asynchronous connection pooling with asyncpg and pool recycling
feynman_prompts: Why is connection pooling essential for high-concurrency FastAPI applications?
key_misconceptions: Opening and closing a new database connection on every single HTTP request

nodes.title: Caching & In-Memory Data with Redis
nodes.subtitle: redis-py, async Redis client, Cache-Aside pattern, serialization, key expiration
learning_objectives: Implement fast in-memory caching using asynchronous Redis clients
Cache expensive query results with automatic TTL invalidation
feynman_prompts: How does caching reduce database load and improve p99 API response latency?
key_misconceptions: Caching un-serialized Python object references instead of standardized JSON strings

nodes.title: Background Tasks with Celery & Redis
nodes.subtitle: Celery app, worker processes, broker & backend, task retries, dead-letter queues
learning_objectives: Offload long-running background jobs (emails, report generation) to Celery workers
Configure automatic task retries with exponential backoff and dead-letter queues
feynman_prompts: Why should heavy computational or external network calls never run inside the HTTP request thread?
key_misconceptions: Passing massive database entity objects into Celery tasks instead of passing object IDs

nodes.title: Automated Testing with Pytest & Fixtures
nodes.subtitle: pytest, pytest-asyncio, fixtures, mocking with unittest.mock / respx, test coverage
learning_objectives: Write deterministic unit and integration tests using pytest and async fixtures
Mock external HTTP APIs and database sessions cleanly with respx and mock fixtures
feynman_prompts: Why are pytest fixtures superior to traditional xUnit setUp/tearDown methods?
key_misconceptions: Writing tests that run against live third-party external APIs

nodes.title: Authentication: JWT, OAuth2 & Password Hashing
nodes.subtitle: passlib / bcrypt, OAuth2PasswordBearer, JWT tokens, refresh tokens, scopes
learning_objectives: Hash passwords securely using bcrypt with appropriate salt work factor
Issue and verify asymmetric JWT access tokens with expiration timestamps
feynman_prompts: Why should password hashing algorithms intentionally be computationally expensive?
key_misconceptions: Storing unencrypted plain passwords in database columns

nodes.title: Dockerizing Python Applications for Production
nodes.subtitle: Multi-stage Dockerfiles, non-root user, slim base images, poetry/uv dependency caching
learning_objectives: Author lean, secure multi-stage Docker images for Python applications
Optimize Docker build layer caching using modern package managers like uv or poetry
feynman_prompts: Why should production Python containers use lightweight slim/alpine base images?
key_misconceptions: Running production Docker containers as root without a dedicated application user

nodes.title: Production Deployment: Uvicorn & Gunicorn
nodes.subtitle: Uvicorn ASGI server, Gunicorn process manager, worker processes, graceful shutdown
learning_objectives: Deploy FastAPI services using Gunicorn with Uvicorn worker processes
Handle graceful server shutdown and configure worker lifecycle management
feynman_prompts: What is the role of Gunicorn as a process manager in front of Uvicorn ASGI workers?
key_misconceptions: Running the development reloader (uvicorn --reload) in production environments

nodes.title: Observability: OpenTelemetry & Prometheus
nodes.subtitle: OpenTelemetry Python SDK, trace context propagation, Prometheus FastAPI instrumentator
learning_objectives: Instrument distributed tracing across microservices with OpenTelemetry
Export real-time API latency and error metrics to Prometheus
feynman_prompts: Why are distributed trace IDs essential when debugging microservice call chains?
key_misconceptions: Relying only on print() statements instead of structured JSON log formatters

nodes.title: Web Security & Hardening (OWASP Top 10)
nodes.subtitle: SQL injection prevention, CORS middleware, rate limiting, security headers, bandit audit
learning_objectives: Protect FastAPI services against common OWASP vulnerabilities
Audit Python dependencies and codebases for known security vulnerabilities with bandit/safety
feynman_prompts: How do parameterized queries in SQLAlchemy prevent SQL injection attacks?
key_misconceptions: Allowing unrestricted CORS origins (origins=['*']) with allow_credentials=True

description: Master Python Backend & Systems with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
